subject: reasoning
question:
O, P, Q, R, W, X and Y are sitting in a straight line, facing north.

Only two people sit to the left of P. Only three people sit between P and W. Only one person sits between W and X. R sits to the immediate left of O. Y is not an immediate neighbour of W.

How many people sit to the right of Q?
solution:
Given: O, P, Q, R, W, X and Y are sitting in a straight line, facing north.

Only two people sit to the left of P. 

Only three people sit between P and W. 

Only one person sits between W and X. 

R sits to the immediate left of O. 

Y is not an immediate neighbour of W. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/afc7d8bbc4281432f70ee526045c13f97fe8ed78af766a80410c5b6152f37a3f.png] 

So, only one person sits to the right of Q.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
